title: pilosella erythrochrista
intro: Pilosella erythrochrista, commonly known as Red-stemmed mouse-ear hawk's-beard, is a species of flowering plant in the sunflower family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella erythrochrista include wound healing, skin protection, and the treatment of gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
